Description: Distance between the prime meridian and an address located to its east or west, expressed in degrees and minutes.

Description: The postal code of the address.

Description: Identifies which address for a person is the primary mailing address.

Description: Company that has validated an address.

Name: Region 1
Description: The county of the trading community architecture address table. The label that the user sees is provided by the localization team for each address style.

Name: Region 2
Description: The state of the trading community architecture address table. The label that the user sees is provided by the localization team for each address style.

Name: Region 3
Description: The province of the trading community architecture address table. The label that the user sees is provided by the localization team for each address style.

Name: Town or City
Description: The name of the town or city of the address.

Name: Validation Status Code
Description: Level of accuracy of an address as determined by an address provider.

Name: Source System ID
Description: A value to uniquely identify this record. This must be unique for the source system owner and business object component.

Name: Source System Owner
Description: The name of the source system used to generate the source system ID.

Name: Globally Unique ID
Description: The globally unique ID. Only available to reference existing records, it cannot be supplied for new records.
